reason: I already charge AngelSense every night and it works, so this would have to beat something I trust. A brand with no reviews and a founding batch of 50 is a gamble I would not take with my mother's safety in a normal week; I would wait for other families to post how it actually held up.
objection: Battery life: I already charge AngelSense every night and live video will be worse. A camera that streams on SOS will drain a device faster than a GPS tracker, and I cannot see that anywhere in the offer.
would_change_my_mind: Honest, verifiable reviews from caregivers in the Facebook groups I read, showing the battery lasts a full day with live video and the SOS connects reliably.
